svg.title: Normal framings on an unknot
svg.desc: Two identical unknotted circles carry different two-vector normal framings. A ribbon follows the first normal vector. The disk-bounding framing represents zero; one full extra turn gives the stable Hopf class eta.

g.text: The same circle, two different normal framings
The framing extends across a disk.
The stabilized Hopf class has order 2.
After adding normal directions, the parity of an extra twist remains.
